name: Ishikoshi (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Ishikoshi town emblem in white: a broken ring with a hooked tail, like a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former town of Ishikoshi in Miyagi Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-04-01.

features.role: Ishikoshi town emblem — a broken ring with a hooked tail, like a stylised character
